snippet.title: HOLD MY WHEEL | Coop Chaos
snippet.description:
Hold My Wheel" is a chaotic cooperative survival game set in a wacky post-apocalypse. Grab your friends, hop on the bus, and try to keep it from falling apart as you navigate the wasteland!

Work together (or just create more chaos) to survive the ultimate road trip.

Features:

Hilarious 4-player cooperative gameplay.
A customizable, high-maintenance survival bus.
Randomly generated post-apocalyptic road trips.
Plenty of "accidents" and laughs with friends!
Subscribe to stay updated on the full release and dev logs!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4410360/HOLD_MY_WHEEL/
